## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Security / release checklist

- [ ] No secrets, service-role keys, private keys, tokens, passwords, or production `.env` files are included.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have been reviewed for license, provenance, commercial use, and security risk.
- [ ] CodeQL and dependency/secret checks pass.
- [ ] Changes do not weaken authentication, authorization, RLS, or audit behavior.
- [ ] Production-impacting changes are reversible or have a rollback plan.
- [ ] I reviewed generated/build artifacts and did not commit local Unity caches or credentials.
